cards.label: Forty minutes later
cards.text: The police were called by a neighbour and left without much interest. You gave a statement that was technically accurate in every detail that didn't matter. The raider is gone. Your ore is still here.
Archie arrives at seven in the morning with two coffees and the air of a man who expected this.

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "Yeah. They didn't get anything. Used one of the pearls."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Did you now." He looks at you. "That first fight was brutal. This one you won with something you made. Remember the difference."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "And this place is a liability. One lock, a window that doesn't close. You might as well put a sign up."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "You need to move. Somewhere with a proper door. That means a deposit, and a deposit means cash. Rent first, obviously. Then the deposit."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "I'll line you up some help. Des. Best prospector I know, and he's got a use for you. Don't mention the twenty quid."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Official partners, while I'm here. I look out for you, you look out for me. I know a bloke who does security installs. Reasonable price, no questions. And the vein I promised: time, Whitechapel. Yours. It needs work before it pays."
He finishes his coffee and leaves before you can thank him. You check your phone. There's a pin location. The vein.
